name: @repo/page-preloader
description: A page-preloader curtain that plays once and then uncovers the page.

useCases: Full-screen loading curtain shown once on first app load
Branded splash reveal before route content mounts
Section-scoped loading cover inside a bounded container
compositionHints: Mount once near the app root and control with the active prop
Pair with shader-reveal-transition for the in-page state changes that follow
